   - **src/components/drumpad/DrumpadControls.tsx** — Kit selector, routine buttons, record/play/stop/loop/clear, speed slider
   - **src/components/drumpad/RecordingTimeline.tsx** — Horizontal bar with colored dots for recorded hits
   - **src/app/drumpad/page.tsx** — Page route with Header, PadGrid, DrumpadControls, RecordingTimeline

   - **src/lib/drumpad/routines.ts** — 8 pre-built routines
     - `Routine` interface: name, description, bpm, kit, hits (RecordedHit[])
     - `buildHits(bpm, pattern)` helper converts [sixteenth_pos, padId, velocity] tuples to RecordedHit[]
     - Routines: Boom Bap (90), House (124), Trap (140), Funky Break (105), Latin (100), Purdie Shuffle (96, triplet-based), Disco (115), Tom Fill (120)
     - Purdie Shuffle uses manual triplet calculation instead of buildHits

   - **src/lib/launchpad/types.ts** — Grid constants (4×12), PAD_KEY_LABELS, PAD_KEY_CODES for all 48 pads
   - **src/lib/launchpad/packs.ts** — Exact mirror of all 6 Launchpad sound packs with SoundPack interface containing mappings (4 chains × 48 entries), holdToPlay, linkedAreas
   - **src/lib/launchpad/SampleEngine.ts** — Sample loading and playback
     - `loadPack(pack)` fetches all MP3s for a pack, decodes to AudioBuffer, caches in Map
     - `playSample(pack, chain, padIndex)` stops current pad, handles linked areas, plays AudioBufferSourceNode
     - `stopPad(padIndex)` ramps gain to 0
     - `isHoldToPlay(pack, chain, padIndex)` checks holdToPlay arrays
   - **src/lib/store/useLaunchpadStore.ts** — Zustand store for launchpad with setPack, setChain, triggerPad, releasePad
   - **src/lib/hooks/useLaunchpadKeyboard.ts** — Full 47-key keyboard mapping, arrow keys for chain switching (Left=0, Up=1, Right=3, Down=2)

## Drum Practice App - Beat Grid & Practice View Architecture

I've thoroughly explored the codebase and here's a complete overview of how the beat grid, practice views, and pattern display system works:

---

## 1. **Core Components Structure**

### **BeatGrid Component** (`/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/components/sequencer/BeatGrid.tsx`)
The main grid container that displays an entire drum pattern with visual layout.

**Key Features:**
- Displays sticking labels (R/L for rudiments) at the top if pattern includes sticking
- Beat number indicators showing measure positions
- Maps through all tracks and renders TrackRow components
- Receives optional `stepAccuracies` prop to overlay timing grades from live practice

**Props:**
```typescript
interface BeatGridProps {
  stepAccuracies?: Record<string, TimingGrade>;
}
```

**Subdivision Logic:**
- 8th notes = 2 steps per beat
- 16th notes = 4 steps per beat  
- Triplets = 3 steps per beat

---

### **TrackRow Component** (`/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/components/sequencer/TrackRow.tsx`)
Represents a single instrument track with all its steps and a mute button.

**Key Features:**
- **Instrument Label Button** (left side, ~100px width):
  - Shows instrument name (e.g., "Hi-Hat", "Snare", "Kick")
  - Clickable to toggle mute/unmute
  - Styling: Truncated text, hover effects, grayed out when muted
  
- **Step Grid** (right side):
  - Renders BeatCell components for each step in the track
  - Spaced with `gap-0.5` (sm:gap-1)
  
**Props:**
```typescript
interface TrackRowProps {
  track: Track;
  trackIndex: number;
  currentStep: number;
  stepsPerBeat: number;
  onToggleStep: (trackIndex: number, stepIndex: number) => void;
  onToggleMute: (trackIndex: number) => void;
  stepAccuracies?: Record<string, TimingGrade>;
}
```

**Track Data Structure:**
```typescript
interface Track {
  instrumentId: InstrumentId;           // e.g., 'kick', 'snare'
  label: string;                        // Display name
  steps: Step[];                        // Array of step data
  muted: boolean;                       // Mute toggle
  volume: number;                       // 0.0 - 1.0
}
```

---

### **BeatCell Component** (`/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/components/sequencer/BeatCell.tsx`)
Individual clickable step cell - the core visual unit of the grid.

**Key Features:**
- **Size:** 9x9px (sm: 10x10px)
- **Instrument Colors:** Each drum has a distinct color
- **State Indicators:**
  - `isCurrent`: White ring with scale-up effect (currently playing)
  - `isDownbeat`: Darker border/background
  - `active`: Filled with instrument color
  - `accent`: Brighter/enhanced appearance

**Props:**
```typescript
interface BeatCellProps {
  active: boolean;
  accent: boolean;
  isCurrent: boolean;
  isDownbeat: boolean;
  instrumentId: InstrumentId;
  onClick: () => void;
  accuracyGrade?: TimingGrade | null;
}
```

**Instrument Color Map:**
```typescript
const instrumentColors: Record<InstrumentId, string> = {
  'kick': 'bg-red-500',
  'snare': 'bg-yellow-400',
  'hihat-closed': 'bg-cyan-400',
  'hihat-open': 'bg-cyan-300',
  'tom-high': 'bg-purple-400',
  'tom-mid': 'bg-purple-500',
  'tom-low': 'bg-purple-600',
  'crash': 'bg-orange-400',
  'ride': 'bg-green-400',
};
```

**Accuracy Overlay Colors** (used in live practice):
```typescript
const gradeOverlayColors: Record<TimingGrade, string> = {
  perfect: 'ring-green-400 bg-green-400/30',
  great: 'ring-lime-400 bg-lime-400/20',
  good: 'ring-yellow-400 bg-yellow-400/20',
  early: 'ring-orange-400 bg-orange-400/20',
  late: 'ring-orange-400 bg-orange-400/20',
  miss: 'ring-red-500 bg-red-500/30',
};
```

---

## 2. **Data Structures**

### **DrumPattern** (`/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/lib/patterns/types.ts`)
Complete pattern definition:

```typescript
interface DrumPattern {
  id: string;                           // Unique identifier
  name: string;                         // Display name
  description: string;                  // User description
  category: PatternCategory;            // rock | funk | latin | world | rudiment | jazz | electronic | polyrhythm
  timeSignature: TimeSignature;         // { beats: 4, noteValue: 4 }
  subdivision: Subdivision;             // '8th' | '16th' | 'triplet'
  defaultBpm: number;                   // Default tempo
  totalSteps: number;                   // Total steps in pattern (e.g., 8, 16, 12)
  tracks: Track[];                      // Array of instrument tracks
  tags: string[];                       // Search/categorization tags
  sticking?: Hand[];                    // Optional: R/L hand indicators for rudiments
}
```

### **Step** (Individual drum hit)
```typescript
interface Step {
  active: boolean;                      // Whether this step has a note
  velocity: number;                     // 0.0 - 1.0 (affects volume/articulation)
  accent: boolean;                      // Emphasized hit
}
```

### **TimingGrade** (Live practice feedback)
```typescript
type TimingGrade = 'perfect' | 'great' | 'good' | 'early' | 'late' | 'miss';

const TIMING_THRESHOLDS = {
  PERFECT: 0.015,                       // Within 15ms
  GREAT: 0.030,                         // Within 30ms
  GOOD: 0.050,                          // Within 50ms
  MAX_WINDOW: 0.100,                    // Max window 100ms
};
```

---

## 3. **Practice Page Integration** (`/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/app/practice/page.tsx`)

**Layout Structure:**
1. **Header** - Navigation
2. **Pattern Info** - Name, time signature, subdivision, reset button
3. **BeatGrid** - Main sequencer display (scrollable horizontally on mobile)
4. **Controls Grid** (3-column):
   - Left: TransportControls + PracticeModeSelector + TempoRampConfig
   - Middle: BpmControl + SwingControl
   - Right: VolumeControl
5. **Help Text** - Keyboard shortcuts

**Key Functionality:**
- Pattern modification tracking with `isModified` flag
- Session tracking (duration, BPM, accuracy)
- Practice modes: 'loop' and 'tempo-ramp'
- Keyboard shortcuts: Space (play/pause), Esc (stop), arrow keys (BPM adjustment)
- Click grid cells to toggle steps

---

## 4. **Live Practice Page Integration** (`/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/app/live/page.tsx`)

**Enhanced Features:**
- **BeatGrid with Accuracy Overlays** - Shows real-time accuracy grades on cells
- **BarHistoryStrip** - Rolling bar-by-bar accuracy visualization
- **TimingIndicator** - Shows last tap timing (early/late/perfect)
- **StreakDisplay** - Current accuracy streak
- **TapPadPanel** - Clickable pads for tapping along
- **LiveStatsPanel** - Real-time statistics (hits, misses, accuracy)
- **Mode Selector** - 'full-kit' or 'single-track' mode
- **Results Modal** - Session summary after stopping

**Key Integration Points:**
```typescript
// Step accuracies passed to BeatGrid for display
const stepAccuracies = useMemo(() => {
  const result: Record<string, TimingGrade> = {};
  for (const [key, acc] of Object.entries(stepAccuraciesRaw)) {
    result[key] = acc.grade;
  }
  return result;
}, [stepAccuraciesRaw]);

// Shown only when actively practicing
<BeatGrid stepAccuracies={isActive || stats.totalExpected > 0 ? stepAccuracies : undefined} />
```

---

## 5. **Pattern Store** (`/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/lib/store/usePatternStore.ts`)

**State Management:**
- `currentPattern`: The active pattern being edited/played
- `isModified`: Tracks if pattern has been edited
- `loadPattern()`: Load a pattern from library
- `toggleStep()`: Enable/disable a step
- `setTrackVolume()`: Adjust individual track volume
- `toggleTrackMute()`: Mute/unmute a track
- `resetPattern()`: Revert to original pattern

---

## 6. **Live Practice Store** (`/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/lib/store/useLivePracticeStore.ts`)

**Tracks:**
- `stepAccuracies`: Record mapping "step-instrumentId" → TimingGrade
- `stats`: SessionStats with detailed analytics
- `barHistory`: Rolling history of bar-by-bar accuracy
- `mode`: 'full-kit' or 'single-track'
- `focusedTrack`: Which track to focus on (single-track mode)

**Key Methods:**
- `setStepAccuracy()`: Record a single step's accuracy
- `recordMiss()`: Log a missed beat
- `recordBarEnd()`: Calculate bar accuracy and store
- `recordTap()`: Process a user tap with timing analysis

---

## 7. **Routine/Pattern Examples** (`/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/lib/drumpad/routines.ts`)

Example routine structure (used in drumpad recorder):
```typescript
interface Routine {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  bpm: number;
  kit: number;
  hits: RecordedHit[];
}
```

Example patterns in patterns/rock.ts show how patterns are built:
```typescript
const basicRockBeat: DrumPattern = {
  id: 'rock-basic',
  name: 'Basic Rock Beat',
  // ... metadata
  tracks: [
    { 
      instrumentId: 'hihat-closed', 
      label: 'Hi-Hat', 
      muted: false, 
      volume: 0.7, 
      steps: boolsToSteps([1,1,1,1,1,1,1,1]) 
    },
    // ... more tracks
  ],
};
```

---

## 8. **Visual Layout Summary**

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ BEAT GRID CONTAINER (gray-900/50 background)        │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ [Sticking Labels] R L R L R L R L R L R L R L R L  │
│ (if pattern has sticking)                           │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ [Beat Numbers]    1   &   2   &   3   &   4   &    │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Hi-Hat      │ [●][●][●][●][●][●][●][●]            │ (cyan)
│ Snare       │ [ ][ ][●][ ][ ][ ][●][ ]            │ (yellow)
│ Kick        │ [●][ ][ ][ ][●][ ][ ][ ]            │ (red)
│             │ ^ current step highlighted with ring │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Cell dimensions: 9x9px (10x10px on desktop)         │
│ Gaps: 0.5 (2px) vertical, 1px horizontal on mobile  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Key Insights for Implementation

1. **Step Accuracy Key Format**: Uses "stepIndex-instrumentId" (e.g., "0-kick", "5-snare")
2. **Downbeat Calculation**: `isDownbeat = stepIndex % stepsPerBeat === 0`
3. **Current Step Animation**: Ring-2 white ring with scale-105 when playing
4. **Accuracy Overlay**: Only shown when actively recording (isActive || stats.totalExpected > 0)
5. **Responsive Design**: Adapts cell sizes and gaps between mobile and desktop
6. **Mutable Pattern Editing**: Live editing support - changes immediately reflected during playback
7. **Session Persistence**: All practice sessions saved to history with accuracy metrics

---

This architecture provides a clean, responsive beat grid interface that supports both editing and real-time accuracy feedback for practice sessions.

```typescript
  GREAT: 0.030,                         // Within 30ms
  GOOD: 0.050,                          // Within 50ms
  MAX_WINDOW: 0.100,                    // Max window 100ms
};
```

---

## 3. **Practice Page Integration** (`/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/app/practice/page.tsx`)

**Layout Structure:**
1. **Header** - Navigation
2. **Pattern Info** - Name, time signature, subdivision, reset button
3. **BeatGrid** - Main sequencer display (scrollable horizontally on mobile)
4. **Controls Grid** (3-column):
   - Left: TransportControls + PracticeModeSelector + TempoRampConfig
   - Middle: BpmControl + SwingControl
   - Right: VolumeControl
5. **Help Text** - Keyboard shortcuts

**Key Functionality:**
- Pattern modification tracking with `isModified` flag
- Session tracking (duration, BPM, accuracy)
- Practice modes: 'loop' and 'tempo-ramp'
- Keyboard shortcuts: Space (play/pause), Esc (stop), arrow keys (BPM adjustment)
- Click grid cells to toggle steps

---

## 4. **Live Practice Page Integration** (`/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/app/live/page.tsx`)

**Enhanced Features:**
- **BeatGrid with Accuracy Overlays** - Shows real-time accuracy grades on cells
- **BarHistoryStrip** - Rolling bar-by-bar accuracy visualization
- **TimingIndicator** - Shows last tap timing (early/late/perfect)
- **StreakDisplay** - Current accuracy streak
- **TapPadPanel** - Clickable pads for tapping along
- **LiveStatsPanel** - Real-time statistics (hits, misses, accuracy)
- **Mode Selector** - 'full-kit' or 'single-track' mode
- **Results Modal** - Session summary after stopping

**Key Integration Points:**
```typescript
// Step accuracies passed to BeatGrid for display
const stepAccuracies = useMemo(() => {
  const result: Record<string, TimingGrade> = {};
  for (const [key, acc] of Object.entries(stepAccuraciesRaw)) {
    result[key] = acc.grade;
  }
  return result;
}, [stepAccuraciesRaw]);

// Shown only when actively practicing
<BeatGrid stepAccuracies={isActive || stats.totalExpected > 0 ? stepAccuracies : undefined} />
```

---

## 5. **Pattern Store** (`/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/lib/store/usePatternStore.ts`)

**State Management:**
- `currentPattern`: The active pattern being edited/played
- `isModified`: Tracks if pattern has been edited
- `loadPattern()`: Load a pattern from library
- `toggleStep()`: Enable/disable a step
- `setTrackVolume()`: Adjust individual track volume
- `toggleTrackMute()`: Mute/unmute a track
- `resetPattern()`: Revert to original pattern

---

## 6. **Live Practice Store** (`/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/lib/store/useLivePracticeStore.ts`)

**Tracks:**
- `stepAccuracies`: Record mapping "step-instrumentId" → TimingGrade
- `stats`: SessionStats with detailed analytics
- `barHistory`: Rolling history of bar-by-bar accuracy
- `mode`: 'full-kit' or 'single-track'
- `focusedTrack`: Which track to focus on (single-track mode)

**Key Methods:**
- `setStepAccuracy()`: Record a single step's accuracy
- `recordMiss()`: Log a missed beat
- `recordBarEnd()`: Calculate bar accuracy and store
- `recordTap()`: Process a user tap with timing analysis

---

## 7. **Routine/Pattern Examples** (`/Users/chiu.fyi/work/drum-practice/src/lib/drumpad/routines.ts`)

Example routine structure (used in drumpad recorder):
```typescript
interface Routine {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  bpm: number;
  kit: number;
  hits: RecordedHit[];
}
```

Example patterns in patterns/rock.ts show how patterns are built:
```typescript
const basicRockBeat: DrumPattern = {
  id: 'rock-basic',
  name: 'Basic Rock Beat',
  // ... metadata
  tracks: [
    { 
      instrumentId: 'hihat-closed', 
      label: 'Hi-Hat', 
      muted: false, 
      volume: 0.7, 
      steps: boolsToSteps([1,1,1,1,1,1,1,1]) 
    },
    // ... more tracks
  ],
};
```

---

## 8. **Visual Layout Summary**

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ BEAT GRID CONTAINER (gray-900/50 background)        │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ [Sticking Labels] R L R L R L R L R L R L R L R L  │
│ (if pattern has sticking)                           │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ [Beat Numbers]    1   &   2   &   3   &   4   &    │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Hi-Hat      │ [●][●][●][●][●][●][●][●]            │ (cyan)
│ Snare       │ [ ][ ][●][ ][ ][ ][●][ ]            │ (yellow)
│ Kick        │ [●][ ][ ][ ][●][ ][ ][ ]            │ (red)
│             │ ^ current step highlighted with ring │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Cell dimensions: 9x9px (10x10px on desktop)         │
│ Gaps: 0.5 (2px) vertical, 1px horizontal on mobile  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Key Insights for Implementation

1. **Step Accuracy Key Format**: Uses "stepIndex-instrumentId" (e.g., "0-kick", "5-snare")
2. **Downbeat Calculation**: `isDownbeat = stepIndex % stepsPerBeat === 0`
3. **Current Step Animation**: Ring-2 white ring with scale-105 when playing
4. **Accuracy Overlay**: Only shown when actively recording (isActive || stats.totalExpected > 0)
5. **Responsive Design**: Adapts cell sizes and gaps between mobile and desktop
6. **Mutable Pattern Editing**: Live editing support - changes immediately reflected during playback
7. **Session Persistence**: All practice sessions saved to history with accuracy metrics

---

This architecture provides a clean, responsive beat grid interface that supports both editing and real-time accuracy feedback for practice sessions.

import { PadVoiceId, RecordedHit } from './types';

export interface Routine {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  bpm: number;
  kit: number; // recommended kit index
  hits: RecordedHit[];

// Helper: build hits from [sixteenth_position, padId, velocity] tuples
function buildHits(
  bpm: number,
  pattern: [number, PadVoiceId, number][]
): RecordedHit[] {
  const sixteenth = 60 / bpm / 4;
  return pattern.map(([pos, padId, velocity]) => ({
    padId,
    timestamp: pos * sixteenth,
    velocity,
  }));
}

  hits: (() => {

      h(20, 'snare', 0.3),
      h(21, 'hihat-closed', 0.7),
      h(21, 'snare', 0.85),
      h(22, 'hihat-closed', 0.3),
      h(22, 'snare', 0.25),

# Drumpad Feature

## Context
Add an MPC/Launchpad-style drumpad page to the drum practice app. Inspired by [Dan12/Launchpad](https://github.com/Dan12/Launchpad) — a 4×12 keyboard-triggered pad grid with visual feedback, sound chain switching, and recording/playback.

## What We're Building
A `/drumpad` route with a 4×4 pad grid, keyboard triggers, recording, and loop playback.

## Files to Create

### 1. Types & Config — `/src/lib/drumpad/types.ts`
- `PadVoiceId` type: 9 original instruments + 7 variants (`kick-deep`, `kick-sub`, `snare-clap`, `snare-rimshot`, `snare-sidestick`, `snare-cross`, `percussion`)
- `PadConfig` interface: id, label, keyCode, keyLabel, color, row/col
- `PAD_CONFIGS` constant: 16 pads mapped to keyboard grid (1234 / QWER / ASDF / ZXCV)
- `CHOKE_GROUPS`: hi-hat closed chokes open
- `KITS`: 4 sound kits (Standard, Electronic, Percussion, Minimal) switchable via arrow keys

Pad layout:
| Row | Col 0 | Col 1 | Col 2 | Col 3 |
|-----|-------|-------|-------|-------|
| 0 (1-4) | Crash | Ride | HH Open | HH Closed |
| 1 (QWER) | Tom Hi | Tom Mid | Tom Lo | Rimshot |
| 2 (ASDF) | Snare | Clap | Sidestick | Cross-stick |
| 3 (ZXCV) | Kick | Deep Kick | Sub | Percussion |

### 2. Audio — `/src/lib/audio/PadVoices.ts`
- `playPadVoice(voiceId, time, velocity, volume)` — delegates to `playInstrument` for original 9, synthesizes the 7 variants directly
- Variant synthesis: kick-deep (lower pitch sweep), kick-sub (sine only), snare-clap (staggered noise bursts), snare-rimshot (short high), snare-sidestick (click only), snare-cross (bandpass muted), percussion (short high tom)
- Choke group handling: track active `GainNode` refs, ramp to 0 on choke

### 3. Store — `/src/lib/store/useDrumpadStore.ts`
- `activePads: Set<PadVoiceId>` — for visual feedback
- `currentKit: number` — kit index (0-3)
- `isRecording / recordedHits / recordingStartTime` — recording state
- `isPlaying / isLooping / playbackBpm / playbackTimerIds` — playback state
- Actions: `triggerPad`, `releasePad`, `setKit`, `startRecording`, `stopRecording`, `clearRecording`, `startPlayback`, `stopPlayback`, `toggleLoop`, `setPlaybackBpm`

### 4. Keyboard Hook — `/src/lib/hooks/useDrumpadKeyboard.ts`
- Maps `KeyboardEvent.code` → pad triggers (guards against `e.repeat`, skips input elements)
- Arrow keys for kit switching

### 5. Components — `/src/components/drumpad/`
- **`DrumPad.tsx`** — Single pad: colored border, glow on press, scale-95 animation, shows label + key shortcut. Touch + mouse support.
- **`PadGrid.tsx`** — `grid grid-cols-4 gap-2`, max-w-lg centered, aspect-square pads
- **`DrumpadControls.tsx`** — Record/play/stop/loop/clear buttons, BPM slider, kit selector
- **`RecordingTimeline.tsx`** — Horizontal bar with colored dots for hits, playback cursor

### 6. Page — `/src/app/drumpad/page.tsx`
- Client component with Header, PadGrid, DrumpadControls, RecordingTimeline

## File to Modify

### `/src/components/Header.tsx`
- Add `{ href: '/drumpad', label: 'Drumpad' }` to drums section nav

## Recording/Playback
- Recording: capture `{ padId, timestamp (relative), velocity }` on each hit
- Playback: `setTimeout`-based scheduling scaled by `playbackBpm` (100 = 1x)
- Loop: re-schedule when last hit plays, loop length rounded to nearest 0.5s

## Verification
1. `npm run build` — no type errors
2. Navigate to `/drumpad` via header nav
3. Press keyboard keys (1-4, Q-R, A-D, Z-V) — hear sounds, see pad glow
4. Click/tap pads on mobile — same behavior
5. Hit record, play some hits, stop, hit play — hear playback
6. Toggle loop — playback repeats
7. Switch kits with arrow keys — different sound assignments
8. Hit closed hi-hat while open is ringing — open cuts off (choke)

# Routine Beat Grid Display

## Context
Routines are currently shown as cards with a mini waveform visualization. The user wants to see them as a readable beat grid (like the practice page's step sequencer) so they can read the pattern and try to replicate it on the pads.

## Approach
Convert each routine's `RecordedHit[]` timestamps back into a step-sequencer grid and render it using a read-only version of the existing BeatGrid visual style. This gives a familiar drum tab view: instrument labels on the left, steps across, color-coded cells, beat numbers on top.

## Data Transformation — `routineToGrid()` utility

Add to `src/lib/drumpad/routines.ts`:

```ts
interface RoutineGridData {
  instruments: { id: PadVoiceId; label: string }[];
  totalSteps: number;
  stepsPerBeat: number;
  beats: number; // time signature beats per bar
  bars: number;
  grid: Map<PadVoiceId, { active: boolean; velocity: number }[]>;
}
```

Logic:
- Detect subdivision: if routine is Purdie Shuffle (triplet-based), use `stepsPerBeat=3`; otherwise `stepsPerBeat=4` (sixteenths)
- Calculate `sixteenthDuration = 60 / bpm / 4` (or triplet equivalent)
- For each hit, compute `stepIndex = Math.round(hit.timestamp / stepDuration)`
- Collect unique instrument IDs used in the routine, ordered by instrument type (cymbals → snares → kicks, matching the BeatGrid convention of hi-hat at top, kick at bottom)
- Build a grid map: for each instrument, an array of `{ active, velocity }` per step

Fractional positions (trap 32nd notes at 3.5, 11.5 etc.) get rounded to nearest 16th — acceptable tradeoff vs doubling grid resolution.

## New Component — `src/components/drumpad/RoutineGrid.tsx`

A read-only beat grid that renders a routine's pattern. Reuses the same visual style as `BeatCell`/`TrackRow`/`BeatGrid` but self-contained (no store dependencies, no click handlers).

Props:
```ts
interface RoutineGridProps {
  routine: Routine;
  currentStep?: number; // playback cursor position, -1 or undefined = not playing
}
```

Structure:
- Beat number header row (1, 2, 3, 4 per bar, with bar separator)
- One row per instrument used in the routine
- Each cell: colored square if active (instrument color, opacity scaled by velocity), dark bg if inactive
- Downbeat cells have slightly brighter border
- Current step gets white ring highlight (like existing BeatCell)
- Instrument label column on the left (~80px)

Voice label mapping (reuse from existing `PadConfig` labels or define inline):
```
kick → Kick, kick-deep → Deep Kick, kick-sub → Sub,
snare → Snare, snare-clap → Clap, snare-rimshot → Rimshot, etc.
hihat-closed → HH Closed, hihat-open → HH Open,
tom-high → Tom Hi, tom-mid → Tom Mid, tom-low → Tom Lo,
crash → Crash, ride → Ride, percussion → Perc
```

Instrument color mapping (matches existing `BeatCell` colors extended for variants):
```
kick/kick-deep/kick-sub → red
snare/snare-clap/snare-rimshot/snare-sidestick/snare-cross → yellow
hihat-closed/hihat-open → cyan
tom-high/tom-mid/tom-low → purple
crash → orange, ride → green, percussion → purple
```

Instrument display order (top to bottom): hihat-closed, hihat-open, ride, crash, snare, snare-clap, snare-rimshot, snare-sidestick, snare-cross, tom-high, tom-mid, tom-low, kick, kick-deep, kick-sub, percussion — only showing instruments that actually appear in the routine.

## Playback Cursor Tracking

Add to `useDrumpadStore`:
- `playbackStep: number` — current step position during playback (-1 when not playing)
- Updated in `startPlayback()`: schedule a step-update timer alongside each loop iteration that increments `playbackStep` every `stepDuration` ms
- Reset to -1 in `stopPlayback()`

## Integration — `DrumpadControls.tsx`

When a routine is active (`activeRoutineName !== null`), show the `RoutineGrid` below the routine cards section:
```tsx
{activeRoutineName && activeRoutine && (
  <RoutineGrid routine={activeRoutine} currentStep={playbackStep} />
)}
```

The routine cards grid stays as-is (the RoutineCard components already handle load/play toggle).

## Files to Create
- `src/components/drumpad/RoutineGrid.tsx` — the read-only beat grid component + `routineToGrid()` utility

## Files to Modify
- `src/lib/store/useDrumpadStore.ts` — add `playbackStep` state + step tracking in playback
- `src/components/drumpad/DrumpadControls.tsx` — render `RoutineGrid` when routine is active

## Verification
1. `npm run build` — no type errors
2. Load a routine on `/drumpad` — grid appears below routine cards
3. Grid shows correct instruments and step positions matching the routine
4. Beat numbers align with bars (1-2-3-4 repeated)
5. Press play — white cursor moves through the grid in sync with audio
6. Stop — cursor disappears
7. Switch routines — grid updates to new pattern
8. Purdie Shuffle shows triplet grid (3 steps per beat instead of 4)

## Context
Add an MPC/Launchpad-style drumpad page to the drum practice app. Inspired by [Dan12/Launchpad](https://github.com/Dan12/Launchpad) — a 4×12 keyboard-triggered pad grid with visual feedback, sound chain switching, and recording/playback.

## What We're Building
A `/drumpad` route with a 4×4 pad grid, keyboard triggers, recording, and loop playback.

## Files to Create

### 1. Types & Config — `/src/lib/drumpad/types.ts`
- `PadVoiceId` type: 9 original instruments + 7 variants (`kick-deep`, `kick-sub`, `snare-clap`, `snare-rimshot`, `snare-sidestick`, `snare-cross`, `percussion`)
- `PadConfig` interface: id, label, keyCode, keyLabel, color, row/col
- `PAD_CONFIGS` constant: 16 pads mapped to keyboard grid (1234 / QWER / ASDF / ZXCV)
- `CHOKE_GROUPS`: hi-hat closed chokes open
- `KITS`: 4 sound kits (Standard, Electronic, Percussion, Minimal) switchable via arrow keys

Pad layout:
| Row | Col 0 | Col 1 | Col 2 | Col 3 |
|-----|-------|-------|-------|-------|
| 0 (1-4) | Crash | Ride | HH Open | HH Closed |
| 1 (QWER) | Tom Hi | Tom Mid | Tom Lo | Rimshot |
| 2 (ASDF) | Snare | Clap | Sidestick | Cross-stick |
| 3 (ZXCV) | Kick | Deep Kick | Sub | Percussion |

### 2. Audio — `/src/lib/audio/PadVoices.ts`
- `playPadVoice(voiceId, time, velocity, volume)` — delegates to `playInstrument` for original 9, synthesizes the 7 variants directly
- Variant synthesis: kick-deep (lower pitch sweep), kick-sub (sine only), snare-clap (staggered noise bursts), snare-rimshot (short high), snare-sidestick (click only), snare-cross (bandpass muted), percussion (short high tom)
- Choke group handling: track active `GainNode` refs, ramp to 0 on choke

### 3. Store — `/src/lib/store/useDrumpadStore.ts`
- `activePads: Set<PadVoiceId>` — for visual feedback
- `currentKit: number` — kit index (0-3)
- `isRecording / recordedHits / recordingStartTime` — recording state
- `isPlaying / isLooping / playbackBpm / playbackTimerIds` — playback state
- Actions: `triggerPad`, `releasePad`, `setKit`, `startRecording`, `stopRecording`, `clearRecording`, `startPlayback`, `stopPlayback`, `toggleLoop`, `setPlaybackBpm`

### 4. Keyboard Hook — `/src/lib/hooks/useDrumpadKeyboard.ts`
- Maps `KeyboardEvent.code` → pad triggers (guards against `e.repeat`, skips input elements)
- Arrow keys for kit switching

### 5. Components — `/src/components/drumpad/`
- **`DrumPad.tsx`** — Single pad: colored border, glow on press, scale-95 animation, shows label + key shortcut. Touch + mouse support.
- **`PadGrid.tsx`** — `grid grid-cols-4 gap-2`, max-w-lg centered, aspect-square pads
- **`DrumpadControls.tsx`** — Record/play/stop/loop/clear buttons, BPM slider, kit selector
- **`RecordingTimeline.tsx`** — Horizontal bar with colored dots for hits, playback cursor

### 6. Page — `/src/app/drumpad/page.tsx`
- Client component with Header, PadGrid, DrumpadControls, RecordingTimeline

### `/src/components/Header.tsx`
- Add `{ href: '/drumpad', label: 'Drumpad' }` to drums section nav

- Recording: capture `{ padId, timestamp (relative), velocity }` on each hit

# Routine Beat Grid Display

## Context
Routines are currently shown as cards with a mini waveform visualization. The user wants to see them as a readable beat grid (like the practice page's step sequencer) so they can read the pattern and try to replicate it on the pads.

## Approach
Convert each routine's `RecordedHit[]` timestamps back into a step-sequencer grid and render it using a read-only version of the existing BeatGrid visual style. This gives a familiar drum tab view: instrument labels on the left, steps across, color-coded cells, beat numbers on top.

## Data Transformation — `routineToGrid()` utility

Add to `src/lib/drumpad/routines.ts`:

```ts
interface RoutineGridData {
  instruments: { id: PadVoiceId; label: string }[];
  totalSteps: number;
  stepsPerBeat: number;
  beats: number; // time signature beats per bar
  bars: number;
  grid: Map<PadVoiceId, { active: boolean; velocity: number }[]>;
}
```

Logic:
- Detect subdivision: if routine is Purdie Shuffle (triplet-based), use `stepsPerBeat=3`; otherwise `stepsPerBeat=4` (sixteenths)
- Calculate `sixteenthDuration = 60 / bpm / 4` (or triplet equivalent)
- For each hit, compute `stepIndex = Math.round(hit.timestamp / stepDuration)`
- Collect unique instrument IDs used in the routine, ordered by instrument type (cymbals → snares → kicks, matching the BeatGrid convention of hi-hat at top, kick at bottom)
- Build a grid map: for each instrument, an array of `{ active, velocity }` per step

Fractional positions (trap 32nd notes at 3.5, 11.5 etc.) get rounded to nearest 16th — acceptable tradeoff vs doubling grid resolution.

## New Component — `src/components/drumpad/RoutineGrid.tsx`

A read-only beat grid that renders a routine's pattern. Reuses the same visual style as `BeatCell`/`TrackRow`/`BeatGrid` but self-contained (no store dependencies, no click handlers).

Props:
```ts
interface RoutineGridProps {
  routine: Routine;
  currentStep?: number; // playback cursor position, -1 or undefined = not playing
}
```

Structure:
- Beat number header row (1, 2, 3, 4 per bar, with bar separator)
- One row per instrument used in the routine
- Each cell: colored square if active (instrument color, opacity scaled by velocity), dark bg if inactive
- Downbeat cells have slightly brighter border
- Current step gets white ring highlight (like existing BeatCell)
- Instrument label column on the left (~80px)

Voice label mapping (reuse from existing `PadConfig` labels or define inline):
```
kick → Kick, kick-deep → Deep Kick, kick-sub → Sub,
snare → Snare, snare-clap → Clap, snare-rimshot → Rimshot, etc.
hihat-closed → HH Closed, hihat-open → HH Open,
tom-high → Tom Hi, tom-mid → Tom Mid, tom-low → Tom Lo,
crash → Crash, ride → Ride, percussion → Perc
```

Instrument color mapping (matches existing `BeatCell` colors extended for variants):
```
kick/kick-deep/kick-sub → red
snare/snare-clap/snare-rimshot/snare-sidestick/snare-cross → yellow
hihat-closed/hihat-open → cyan
tom-high/tom-mid/tom-low → purple
crash → orange, ride → green, percussion → purple
```

Instrument display order (top to bottom): hihat-closed, hihat-open, ride, crash, snare, snare-clap, snare-rimshot, snare-sidestick, snare-cross, tom-high, tom-mid, tom-low, kick, kick-deep, kick-sub, percussion — only showing instruments that actually appear in the routine.

## Playback Cursor Tracking

Add to `useDrumpadStore`:
- `playbackStep: number` — current step position during playback (-1 when not playing)
- Updated in `startPlayback()`: schedule a step-update timer alongside each loop iteration that increments `playbackStep` every `stepDuration` ms
- Reset to -1 in `stopPlayback()`

## Integration — `DrumpadControls.tsx`

When a routine is active (`activeRoutineName !== null`), show the `RoutineGrid` below the routine cards section:
```tsx
{activeRoutineName && activeRoutine && (
  <RoutineGrid routine={activeRoutine} currentStep={playbackStep} />
)}
```

The routine cards grid stays as-is (the RoutineCard components already handle load/play toggle).

## Files to Create
- `src/components/drumpad/RoutineGrid.tsx` — the read-only beat grid component + `routineToGrid()` utility

## Files to Modify
- `src/lib/store/useDrumpadStore.ts` — add `playbackStep` state + step tracking in playback
- `src/components/drumpad/DrumpadControls.tsx` — render `RoutineGrid` when routine is active

## Verification
1. `npm run build` — no type errors
2. Load a routine on `/drumpad` — grid appears below routine cards
3. Grid shows correct instruments and step positions matching the routine
4. Beat numbers align with bars (1-2-3-4 repeated)
5. Press play — white cursor moves through the grid in sync with audio
6. Stop — cursor disappears
7. Switch routines — grid updates to new pattern
8. Purdie Shuffle shows triplet grid (3 steps per beat instead of 4)

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

## [0.10.0] - 2026-03-04

### Added
- **Drumpad** (`/drumpad`) — MPC-style 4×4 pad grid for free-play drumming
  - 16 synthesized drum sounds: 9 base instruments + 7 variants (deep kick, sub kick, clap, rimshot, sidestick, cross-stick, percussion)
  - Keyboard mapping on natural QWERTY grid: `1234` / `QWER` / `ASDF` / `ZXCV`
  - 4 switchable kits (Standard, Electronic, Percussion, Minimal) via arrow keys or buttons
  - Hi-hat choke groups — closed hi-hat cuts off ringing open hi-hat
  - Record pad hits with timing, play back with loop and adjustable speed (0.25x–2x)
  - Recording timeline visualization with color-coded hit markers
  - 8 pre-built routines: Boom Bap (90 BPM), House (124), Trap (140), Funky Break (105), Latin (100), Purdie Shuffle (96), Disco (115), Tom Fill (120)
  - Color-coded visual feedback with glow animation on pad press
  - Touch support for mobile
- **Launchpad** (`/launchpad`) — full mirror of [Dan12/Launchpad](https://github.com/Dan12/Launchpad)
  - 4×12 pad grid (48 pads) with sample-based playback
  - 6 sound packs (913 MP3 samples): Equinox, Animals, Electro, Ghet, Kyoto, Aero Chord
  - 4 chains per pack, switchable via arrow keys (← = Chain 1, ↑ = Chain 2, → = Chain 4, ↓ = Chain 3)
  - Hold-to-play mode and linked area (mutually exclusive pad group) support
  - Sample engine with on-demand loading and AudioBuffer caching
  - Full keyboard mapping across 4 rows: `1234567890-=` / `QWERTYUIOP[]` / `ASDFGHJKL;'Enter` / `ZXCVBNM,./Shift`

### Fixed
- Turbopack workspace root resolution when parent directory has its own package.json (`turbopack.root` in next.config.ts)

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

## [0.10.0] - 2026-03-04

### Added
- **Drumpad** (`/drumpad`) — MPC-style 4×4 pad grid for free-play drumming
  - 16 synthesized drum sounds: 9 base instruments + 7 variants (deep kick, sub kick, clap, rimshot, sidestick, cross-stick, percussion)
  - Keyboard mapping on natural QWERTY grid: `1234` / `QWER` / `ASDF` / `ZXCV`
  - 4 switchable kits (Standard, Electronic, Percussion, Minimal) via arrow keys or buttons
  - Hi-hat choke groups — closed hi-hat cuts off ringing open hi-hat
  - Record pad hits with timing, play back with loop and adjustable speed (0.25x–2x)
  - Recording timeline visualization with color-coded hit markers
  - 8 pre-built routines: Boom Bap (90 BPM), House (124), Trap (140), Funky Break (105), Latin (100), Purdie Shuffle (96), Disco (115), Tom Fill (120)
  - Color-coded visual feedback with glow animation on pad press
  - Touch support for mobile
- **Launchpad** (`/launchpad`) — full mirror of [Dan12/Launchpad](https://github.com/Dan12/Launchpad)
  - 4×12 pad grid (48 pads) with sample-based playback
  - 6 sound packs (913 MP3 samples): Equinox, Animals, Electro, Ghet, Kyoto, Aero Chord
  - 4 chains per pack, switchable via arrow keys (← = Chain 1, ↑ = Chain 2, → = Chain 4, ↓ = Chain 3)
  - Hold-to-play mode and linked area (mutually exclusive pad group) support
  - Sample engine with on-demand loading and AudioBuffer caching
  - Full keyboard mapping across 4 rows: `1234567890-=` / `QWERTYUIOP[]` / `ASDFGHJKL;'Enter` / `ZXCVBNM,./Shift`

### Fixed
- Turbopack workspace root resolution when parent directory has its own package.json (`turbopack.root` in next.config.ts)

## [0.8.0] - 2026-02-27

### Added
- **Separate Drums/Piano sections** — Header restructured with two-level navigation; top row for section tabs (Drums, Piano), bottom row for contextual sub-nav. Logo updated to "Music Practice"
- **Note Naming mode** — new sight reading mode where you type the note letter (A-G, with # for sharps) instead of playing on the piano keyboard
- **Popular Melodies** — 10 curated melodies across 3 difficulty levels for guided sight reading practice
  - Beginner: Twinkle Twinkle, Mary Had a Little Lamb, Ode to Joy, Happy Birthday, Hot Cross Buns
  - Intermediate: Für Elise (theme), Canon in D (theme), Greensleeves
  - Advanced: Moonlight Sonata (opening), Chromatic Scale Exercise
  - "Listen" button plays melody reference audio before you practice
  - Scrollable staff for longer melodies with auto-scroll to current note
- **Microphone input** — pitch detection via Web Audio API autocorrelation algorithm for real piano input
  - Mic indicator shows listening status, detected note name, and frequency
  - Input method selector: Computer Keys / Virtual Piano / Microphone
- **Input Method selector** for sight reading — switch between computer keyboard, virtual piano clicks, or microphone

### Changed
- `SightReadingMode` extended with `note-naming` and `melody` modes
- Sight reading store extended with `inputMethod`, `selectedMelodyId`, `submitNoteName`, `startMelody` actions
- Staff component supports `scrollable` prop for horizontal scrolling with auto-scroll
- Sight reading page conditionally renders input areas based on mode and input method

## [0.7.0] - 2026-02-27

### Added
- **Metronome Click** — dedicated sine-wave metronome independent of pattern playback
  - Four modes: Off, All Beats (accent on 1), 2 & 4 only, 1 per Bar
  - Adjustable volume slider
  - Works with all subdivisions (8th, 16th, triplet)
- **Mute Pattern Playback** — toggle to silence the reference pattern, hear only metronome + your taps
- **Mute Tap Sounds** — toggle to silence your own drum hits, forcing internalization of the rhythm
- **Drill Timer** — timed practice mode with preset durations (1, 2, 5, 10 minutes)
  - Countdown display next to play button, pulses red in last 10 seconds
  - Auto-stops session when timer expires
- **Tempo Floor Finder** — analyzes bar-by-bar accuracy after a session to detect the BPM where timing breaks down
  - Groups bars by BPM, finds accuracy cliff (below 70% or 80%)
  - Shows recommended practice tempo (5 BPM below the floor) in results modal
- **Coaching Feedback** — human-readable timing analysis in results modal (up to 3 messages)
  - Per-beat bias: "You're consistently late on beat 3" or "Rushing beat 1"
  - Per-instrument variance: "Your hi-hat timing is the most inconsistent"
  - Bar-half analysis: "Rushing during the second half of each bar"
  - Tempo suggestions: "Clean at 100 BPM — ready to move up 5" or "Try dropping to 85 BPM"

### Changed
- `BarAccuracy` now tracks BPM per bar for tempo floor analysis
- `SessionStats` includes `detailedTaps` array for per-step/per-instrument timing analysis (stripped from localStorage to save space)
- `PracticeSession` extended with optional `drillDurationMs` and `tempoFloor` fields
- Settings store persists metronome mode, metronome volume, mute preferences
- Live practice store tracks drill timer state and bar index for detailed tap recording

## [0.6.0] - 2026-02-27

### Added
- **Floating Grade Toast** — animated label ("Perfect!", "Great +12ms", etc.) floats up and fades after each tap during live practice
- **Timing Deviation Indicator** — horizontal bar showing how early/late each tap is, with color-coded dot (green center → orange edges, ±100ms scale)
- **Streak Combo Display** — combo counter appears at 3+ streak with escalating visual tiers:
  - 3–9: green glow ("Streak")
  - 10–19: yellow pulse ("On Fire")
  - 20+: orange pulsing glow ("Unstoppable")
  - "Streak Lost" flash on break
- **Bar History Strip** — rolling strip of per-bar accuracy blocks below the beat grid, showing last 12 bars color-coded by accuracy
- **Timing Distribution Bar** — stacked colored bar showing percentage breakdown of perfect/great/good/off/miss grades (shown in results modal and progress page)
- **Session Comparison** — results modal now shows accuracy delta vs previous session ("↑12% from last session" or "↓5%")
- **Bar-by-Bar Trend** — mini bar chart in results modal showing accuracy progression across bars within a session
- **Avg Accuracy** tile added to progress dashboard overall stats row
- **Trend Arrows** in progress page per-pattern session list showing accuracy change between sessions

### Changed
- Live practice store tracks `lastTapOffset`, `streakBroken`, and per-bar hit/total counters
- `SessionStats` now includes `barHistory` for post-session analysis
- Results modal redesigned with timing distribution bar, previous session comparison, and bar trend chart
- Progress page pattern details now show timing breakdown bars per session
- Overall stats row expanded from 4 to 5 tiles (added avg accuracy)

## [0.5.0] - 2026-02-19

### Added
- **Practice History & Stats Tracking** — all practice sessions persisted to localStorage
  - Every live session records: pattern, accuracy, BPM, duration, timing stats
  - Loop/tempo-ramp sessions tracked with duration (accuracy only for live mode)
  - Sessions survive page refresh — up to 2,000 sessions stored
- **SM-2 Spaced Repetition** — Anki-style algorithm suggests which patterns to review next
  - Accuracy-to-quality mapping: 95%+ = perfect recall, down to <30% = complete failure
  - Interval progression: 1 day → 6 days → interval × ease factor (capped at 365 days)
  - Ease factor adjusts based on performance (min 1.3, starts at 2.5)
  - Mastery levels: New → Learning → Familiar → Mastered (based on successful repetitions)
- **Progress Dashboard** (`/progress`) — comprehensive practice analytics page
  - Overall stats row: total practice time, session count, patterns practiced, daily streak
  - Due for Review section: horizontal scroll of patterns needing practice, sorted by overdue time
  - Practice Calendar: 12-week GitHub-style heat map showing daily practice intensity
  - Pattern Progress List: per-pattern accordion with accuracy sparklines, best scores, session history
- **Due for Review Banner** on home page — shows count of patterns due with link to progress page
- **Post-session feedback** — "Next review in X days" shown in live results modal after each session
- Header navigation updated with "Progress" link

### Changed
- Live practice page now saves sessions and updates spaced repetition cards on stop
- Practice page now saves loop/tempo-ramp sessions on stop (guard: minimum 5 seconds)
- LiveResultsModal shows next review timing from updated SM-2 card

## [0.4.0] - 2026-02-19

### Added
- **Piano Sight Reading Practice** (`/sight-reading`) — learn to read music notation with a virtual piano
  - Three practice modes: Note Drill (identify single notes), Interval Training (play two-note intervals), Phrase Reading (play short melodies)
  - SVG music staff with treble clef, note heads, sharps, ledger lines
  - On-screen 2-octave piano keyboard (C3-B4) with click/touch support
  - Computer keyboard mapping: Z-M row for C3-B3, Q-U row for C4-B4 (standard DAW layout)
  - Three difficulty levels: Beginner (natural notes, 1 octave), Intermediate (all notes, 2 octaves), Advanced (wider intervals, longer phrases)
  - Real-time stats: accuracy %, streak, best streak, average response time

content.text:
Here's the summary:

**Bug found and fixed:** The `loopDuration` was calculated as `Math.ceil(lastHitTime * 2) / 2 + 0.1` — a time-based heuristic that doesn't align with the musical grid. For example, Boom Bap at 90 BPM had its last hit at 5.0s, giving a loop of 5.1s, but 2 bars at 90 BPM = 5.333s. The loop restarted **233ms early**, causing the jitter you heard.

**Fix:** For routines, `loopDuration` is now computed as `totalSteps × stepDuration`, which gives exact bar-aligned timing. Free-form recordings still use the old heuristic (which is fine for non-quantized input).

**Changelog:** Added v0.10.1 entry documenting the routine grid, routine cards, and the loop timing fix.
